sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
In 'Stunts Car - Impossible Car Challenges', the core gameplay revolves around driving high-speed cars on impossible tracks, performing stunts, and executing precision jumps. The game features a range of sports cars, each with its unique handling and speed characteristics. Players can choose from different tracks, each with its own challenges and obstacles, and compete against other players to set the fastest times.

One of the key features that sets 'Stunts Car - Impossible Car Challenges' apart from other racing games is its focus on stunts and high-speed driving. The game rewards players for performing death-defying stunts, such as jumping over ramps, executing precision drifts, and crashing through obstacles.
